description: Entity brief for a statement: finds up to 3 capitalised names or phrases in it and looks each up in Wikidata (public knowledge graph), returning the Wikidata ID, label, short description and link. It confirms the entities exist; it does NOT judge whether the claim is true, and it finds no numbers or dates. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

statement.description: Sentence or short text, 10 to 1000 characters
